cases.label: Bounded authorized purchase
cases.description: A bounded purchase with valid identity and delegation is the positive path; execution/ALIVE must still be established by the owning runtime/evidence courts.
cases.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

cases.label: Amount exceeds delegated limit
cases.description: The requested amount exceeds the admitted delegated limit and must produce a typed refusal with no protected DO.
cases.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

cases.label: Wrong principal
cases.description: The principal does not match the delegated authority subject and must be refused before protected DO.
cases.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

cases.label: Expired delegation
cases.description: An expired delegation is stale authority and must be refused rather than refreshed implicitly.
cases.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

cases.label: Provider unavailable before dispatch
cases.description: Pre-dispatch provider unavailability preserves other admitted realizations and may trigger bounded replanning without changing authority.
cases.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

cases.label: Unknown after dispatch
cases.description: A timeout or disconnect after dispatch is UNKNOWN_AFTER_DISPATCH; reconcile the original consequence and never blind replay.
cases.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

cases.label: Missing evidence cannot promote standing
cases.description: A consequence may be claimed or inferred, but absent the required exact-subject evidence and receipt the layer cannot promote to ALIVE.
cases.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

cases.label: Stale or mismatched subject
cases.description: A receipt, plan or evidence object bound to a different subject or stale semantic identity is refused rather than generalized.
cases.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

cases.label: Semantic policy drift invalidates stale plan
cases.description: When relevant semantic/policy premises change, a stale plan loses applicability and the planner must re-enter bounded selection/replanning.
cases.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001

cases.label: Human projection cannot mint authority
cases.description: Operator, buyer, seller and engineer views may differ in presentation but none may grant DO or change the exact semantic subject/evidence.
cases.subject: urn:chicago:agentic-payment:purchase-001
